The model predicted that someone has cardiovascular diseases because it found high levels of hypertension in their data. Hypertension is a condition affecting blood pressure in the arteries, which can lead to various heart problems over time. When hypertension is detected, especially if it persists, it increases the risk of developing other cardiovascular diseases such as coronary artery disease, stroke, and heart failure. Therefore, the model flagged this patient as having an increased likelihood of cardiovascular issues due to their elevated blood pressure.
